item.title: USP scholar advances contributions to Pacific Freshwater Ecology
item.description: A PhD scholar at The University of the South Pacific (USP) has made significant contributions to Pacific freshwater ecology, co-authoring the discovery and documentation of eight new endemic species of damselflies and the establishment of a new endemic genus for Fiji. item.title: Father charged with year-long sexual abuse of daughter
item.description: A 49-year-old man from West Sepik has been charged with aggravated rape after allegedly sexually abusing his own daughter over a period of one year. He is now in custody at Buimo Prison. Police say the abuse took place between October 2024 and October 2025 at the family home in a Lae settlement. The man allegedly used knives and iron rods to threaten his daughter and force her into sexual acts. item.description: BYRON Chan has taken an early lead in the New Ireland Provincial by-election, according to progressive results from the primary count of the first five Local Level Governments (LLGs).
